risks.reasoning: For the nine months ended September 30, 2021, the audited cash flow statement reports net cash used in operating activities of RMB174,386 thousand and cash and cash equivalents at period end of RMB1,654,623 thousand. Monthly operating cash burn is approximately RMB19,376 thousand and cash runway is approximately 85.40 months, above the 12-month trigger.

The accountants' report shows a loss for the period/year in each of 2018, 2019, 2020, 9M2020 and 9M2021, with amounts of RMB71,174 thousand, RMB248,359 thousand, RMB360,635 thousand, RMB233,010 thousand and RMB438,019 thousand respectively. Five comparable loss periods exceed the frozen high threshold of at least three comparable loss periods.

Revenue increased from RMB297,639 thousand in 9M2020 to RMB553,015 thousand in 9M2021, an increase of approximately 85.80%. The latest comparable growth is positive and does not trigger the frozen negative-growth thresholds.

For 9M2021, the largest customer accounted for approximately 14.0% and the five largest customers accounted for approximately 44.3% of total revenue. Both ratios remain below the frozen medium thresholds of 30% and 60%.

For 9M2021, the largest supplier accounted for approximately 18.5% and the five largest suppliers accounted for approximately 43.9% of total purchases. Both ratios remain below the frozen medium thresholds of 30% and 60%.

Pre-IPO investors held Redeemable Shares with redemption rights, liquidation preference, anti-dilution, tag-along and drag-along rights. On March 30, 2021, these shareholders waived the redeemable rights against the Company, tag-long rights, drag-along rights, anti-dilution and liquidation preference, and the financial liabilities of redeemable shares were transferred to capital reserve. No restoration of the waived rights is disclosed.

The formal Legal Proceedings and Compliance section states that as of the Latest Practicable Date the Group was not a party to, and was not aware of any threat of, any legal, arbitral or administrative proceedings likely to have a material adverse effect, and that it had complied with applicable laws and regulations in all material respects. No material pending matter was identified.

The Group conducts research and development and sells AI-based software and hardware technology solutions in China. Its core AI-based products and solutions generated substantial revenue throughout the Track Record Period, so the core products are already commercialized and are not a precommercial product stage.
